args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The test suite expects banker's rounding, but round_money was
implemented with ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
half-cent ties round to the nearest even cent.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `round_money` in `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so half-cent ties round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
